Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer pivoted from the authoritative Season 4 YouTube content to a secondary, less relevant source (WatchMojo), initiating an inefficient loop of generic searches and off-target links instead of extracting the CFM values directly from the episode transcript/description. This non-adaptive strategy led to failing to retrieve the correct values (101.376 for Cheater and 84.348 for Cheater Beater) and culminated in an incorrect “unable to obtain” response.
